title: On Preventing the quarrel at the last minute
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：prevent　|　正文 363 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prevent 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the craftsman ① prevented the quarrel at the last minute with great care, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② prevents the quarrel at the last minute on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ prevent the quarrel at the last minute at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ prevented the quarrel at the last minute before — a line in the ledger for August 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Preventing the quarrel at the last minute with great care, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ prevent the damp from the north wall on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Prevent the damp from the north wall at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ prevents the damp from the north wall with great care every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ prevented the quarrel at the last minute again when nobody else would.

⑩ To prevent the quarrel at the last minute, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody prevents the quarrel at the last minute on the same day again and somebody must prevent the quarrel at the last minute with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 阻止（一般过去式 prevented the quarrel at the last minute：1960 年匠人头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 阻止（一般现在 prevents the quarrel at the last minute：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 阻止（不定式 to prevent the quarrel at the last minute：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 阻止（过去完成时 had prevented the quarrel at the last minute：1954 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 阻止（动名词 preventing the quarrel at the last minute 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 防止（prevent the damp from the north wall：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去防止挡住北墙那股潮气）
G. v. 防止（prevent the damp from the north wall：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 阻止（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 prevents the damp from the north wall，而母亲又一次 prevented the quarrel at the last minute）

answers.why: prevent 意为“阻止”，1960 年匠人小心翼翼地阻止最后一刻拦下那场口角，那是工坊里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 prevented。
prevent 意为“阻止”，自那以后匠人当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 prevents。
prevent 意为“阻止”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯阻止最后一刻拦下那场口角”，此处为不定式 to prevent the quarrel at the last minute。
prevent 意为“阻止”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1967 年之前就有人阻止过，故用过去完成时 had prevented。
prevent 意为“阻止”，匠人说“阻止最后一刻拦下那场口角这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 preventing the quarrel at the last minute 作主语。
prevent 意为“防止”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去防止挡住北墙那股潮气”，should ever 之后用原形 prevent the damp from the north wall。
prevent 意为“防止”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻防止挡住北墙那股潮气（prevent the damp from the north wall at once），以后再也不要提起。
prevent 意为“阻止”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例防止挡住北墙那股潮气，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 prevents。
prevent 意为“阻止”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地阻止最后一刻拦下那场口角，用一般过去式 prevented 叙述。
prevent 意为“阻止”，结尾那句是母亲 1972 年的话：要阻止最后一刻拦下那场口角，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 prevent 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the craftsman prevented the quarrel at the last minute with great care, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman prevents the quarrel at the last minute on the same day whenever the workshop asks.
Preventing the quarrel at the last minute with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever prevent the damp from the north wall on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop prevents the damp from the north wall with great care every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother prevented the quarrel at the last minute again, and the workshop remembered that half.
